# Framio

> Framio is a free, MIT-licensed design canvas for coding agents. It renders React and Tailwind designs from files in a developer's repository, with element selection, responsive viewports, and pinned comments.

Framio works with Claude Code, Codex, and other agents that read `.claude/skills` or `.agents/skills`. The canvas runs on localhost. It supports macOS on Apple Silicon and Linux x64 and arm64. It does not include a coding agent or model subscription.

## Documentation

- [Homepage](https://framio.design/): Product overview, workflow, capabilities, and frequently asked questions.
- [Quick start and reference](https://framio.design/docs/): Installation, agent setup, commands, DESIGN.md, comments, and design comparison.
- [Documentation in Markdown](https://framio.design/docs.md): The same documentation as plain Markdown.
- [Full text](https://framio.design/llms-full.txt): Product facts and documentation in one plain-text file.
